_comment: Mandatory protective slayer gear per monster (grZ field request 2026-08-08). Every row wiki-verified 2026-08-08 against the Slayer equipment page plus the monster's own page. Item specs are corpus names, optionally 'name#Version'. The slayer helmet substitutes ONLY where its component would (facemask/earmuffs/nose peg/spiny helmet, plus sourhogs per their page) - never for the gaze shields, boots, gloves, or the bug lantern. Cave horrors are deliberately ABSENT: Protect from Melee fully substitutes the witchwood icon (their MonsterNotes entry carries that).

rules.note: A mirror shield or V's shield is REQUIRED - the gaze drains combat stats every hit, even from a safespot.
